stem: A genetically female plant expresses a small number of male flowers late in development. Which statement is best supported?
choices: Observed sex expression should be recorded separately from genetic sex and evaluated with genotype, stage and environmental context
Its chromosomes must have changed to XY
Any stress always produces the same response in every cultivar
One event proves all progeny will be unstable
rationale: Cannabis floral sex expression is influenced by genetic, hormonal, developmental and environmental factors and is not equivalent to a change in chromosomal sex.
